mode: append-only logical, versioned by Git commits
reconstructed_from_documents: Retrospective backfill, not preregistration. Old before values NOT_RECORDED unless documented explicitly.
source_coverage: 53 source records (not independent cohorts) / 26 qualitative priors / 58 append-only prior revisions
